name: Baker Close Play Area
description: Neighbourhood play area run by East Devon District Council. It was one of the first sites rebuilt in the council's 2026 play area upgrade and has reopened; the upgrade added equipment designed for children of all abilities, such as wheelchair-accessible roundabouts and ground-level trampolines, though the council hasn't listed exactly what went in here.
